latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the SQL Server Toolkit.

- Supports schema creation, versioned migrations, index management, performance diagnostics, backup & restore, and bulk data operations.
- Includes example SQL commands for common tasks such as connecting, running scripts, table creation, indexing, and backups.
- Provides performance diagnostic commands using STATISTICS IO and TIME.
